datasets.name: Structured/Beer
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they describe the same beer from the same brewery. A different beer, variant or vintage from the same brewery is not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/iTunes-Amazon
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they are the same recording of the same song on the same album. A different version or remix, or the same song on a different album, is not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/Fodors-Zagats
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they describe the same restaurant at the same location. Different branches of one chain are not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/DBLP-ACM
datasets.definition: The same paper listed in two bibliographic databases. Author lists may be abbreviated and venue names may differ. A different paper by the same authors is not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/DBLP-GoogleScholar
datasets.definition: The same paper listed in two bibliographic databases. Author lists may be abbreviated and venue names may differ. A different paper by the same authors is not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/Amazon-Google
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they offer the same software product and edition. A different version, platform, license type or bundle is not a match.

datasets.name: Structured/Walmart-Amazon
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they offer the same product model. The same product line in a different size, color, capacity, software version or license bundle is not a match.

datasets.name: Textual/Abt-Buy
datasets.definition: Two listings match when they offer the same product model. The same product line in a different size, color, capacity, software version or license bundle is not a match.
